title: 短对话　听力第一节 · 练习
goal: 听懂短对话中的细节、场景和行动。

points.label: 听出明确细节并识别同义改写
根据话语判断场景与人物关系

sources.title: 2024 年高考综合改革适应性测试 英语（新课标卷）试卷（教育部教育考试院）

lines.text: Excuse me, I ordered a book last week. Has it arrived yet? I need it for my history project.
Let me check your name. Yes, it's here behind the desk. You can borrow it for three weeks.

items.why: 对话提到订书和借书期限，说明地点是图书馆。

lines.text: Shall we meet at the museum at ten on Saturday? The exhibition opens at nine, but I have a class first.
Ten works for me. I'll wait beside the ticket desk, not at the main gate.

items.why: 两人约定十点见面，九点是展览开放时间。

lines.text: I was going to take the bus to the sports centre, but the next one won't come for half an hour.
Then why not walk? It's only fifteen minutes away. I'll come with you.
Good idea. Let's go now.

items.why: 一人提议步行，另一人同意；乘公交是原计划。

lines.text: Could you tell me why my plant's leaves are turning yellow? I water it every morning before school.
The soil feels very wet. Try watering it less often, and keep it near a window rather than outside.

items.stem: What does the second speaker advise?
items.why: 建议减少浇水次数，并放在窗边而不是室外。

lines.text: Have you finished the poster for the school concert? We need to send it to the printer today.
Almost. I still need to add the starting time. Could you check the date while I do that?
Sure, I'll look at the programme.

items.stem: What will the second speaker add to the poster?
items.why: 第二个人要补上开始时间，并请对方核对日期。

lines.text: The pottery class was supposed to start at half past two, wasn't it? I hope we haven't missed the beginning.
No, the teacher moved it to three because the earlier group needed more time to finish their work.

items.stem: When will the pottery class start?
items.why: 老师把开始时间从两点半改到了三点。

lines.text: I'd like to send this parcel to my sister. Could you tell me how much the postage will be?
Certainly. Please put it on the scales first, and I'll check the weight before printing a label for you.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely?
items.why: 对话涉及寄包裹、称重和打印邮寄标签，地点是邮局。

lines.text: Should I send the photographs by email, or would you rather have printed copies for the display tomorrow?
Email them, please. I can choose the best ones and print them here before the hall opens.
All right. I'll send them tonight.

items.stem: What will the first speaker do tonight?
items.why: 第一人同意今晚发邮件；第二人负责挑选和打印。

lines.text: I thought the gardening club met in the science room. Why are all the chairs outside the library today?
The science room is being painted, so we're meeting in the library this week. Next week we'll return to our usual room.

items.stem: Why is the club meeting in the library?
options: The usual room is being painted.
items.why: 科学教室正在粉刷，所以本周改在图书馆集合。

lines.text: We could take the early train, but we'd have to leave home before six. Is there another way to reach the village?
There's a bus at eight. It takes a little longer, but it stops close to the village hall.
Let's take that, then.

items.stem: How will the speakers reach the village?
items.why: 第二人提出乘八点的公交，第一人接受了这个方案。
